source.author: verg
source.text: Ante Iovem nulli subigebant arva coloni; ne signare quidem aut partiri limite campum fas erat: in medium quaerebant ipsaque tellus omnia liberius nullo poscente ferebat.
source.text_original: Ante Iovem nulli subigebant arva coloni; / ne signare quidem aut partiri limite campum / fas erat: in medium quaerebant ipsaque tellus / omnia liberius nullo poscente ferebat.
source.text_english: Before Jove, no farmers subdued the fields; nor was it lawful even to mark off or divide the plain by boundary line: they sought everything in common, and the earth itself, of its own free will and with no one demanding, yielded all things more generously.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: ne signare quidem aut partiri limite campum fas erat: in medium quaerebant, quippe cum deus communem omnibus terram dedisset, ut communem degerent uitam, non ut rabida et furens auaritia sibi omnia uindicaret, nec ulli deesset quod omnibus nasceretur.
reuse.text_original: ne signare quidem aut partiri limite campum fas erat: in medium quaerebant, quippe cum deus communem omnibus terram dedisset, ut communem degerent uitam, non ut rabida et furens auaritia sibi omnia uindicaret, nec ulli deesset quod omnibus nasceretur.
reuse.text_english: It was not even permitted to mark off a field or divide it by a boundary; they sought everything in common, since God had given the earth to all as shared property, so that they might live a common life, not so that ravenous and mad greed might claim everything for itself, nor that anyone should lack what was born for all.
